bounds: One image call, native or ordinary prepaid funding, one immutable logical operation identity, up to four transport attempts. Existing warming and rate-limit branches are abstracted as retry.
limitations: Weak fairness of settling assumes a provider completion, timeout, or caller cancellation is eventually observed. It does not assume provider success.
